description: Measured megakernel step times for advisor validation. A point is either a recorded benchmark job (job_id) or a number from a public source (source_url, marked approximate, with stated assumptions).

points.source_quote: At ~8.5 ms per decode step, the megakernel can deliver over 700 tokens per second to a single user.
assumptions: Context length is not published; 4096 tokens assumed.
The published step may include draft-model time, which the advisor does not price.
points.rows_quote: Each kernel launch evaluates 1 anchor and 7 proposed continuations in a single step.
